title: Highly flame-retarding cotton fabrics with a novel phosphorus/nitrogen intumescent flame retardant
washing_state: Initial treated fabric after tap-water preparation wash; no durability wash
source_material_form_TGA_raw: CFs/APPCABT fabric with 10 wt% APPCABT, Table 3
source_material_form_LOI_raw: Cotton fabric strips, 15.0 × 5.0 cm; Table 2, 10 wt% add-on
treatment_chemistry: APPCABT: source name 6-chloro-4-(diethylamino phosphorate phosphoryl chloride)-2-(sodium 4-aminobenzensulfonate)-1,3,5-triazine.
treatment_method: 100% cotton fabric, 184 g/m², from Santai Fire Resistant Products Co. Ltd., Jinan. Prewash with 0.5% (w/w) NaOH solution in water and dry. Finish in aqueous APPCABT at 90 °C and a liquor ratio of 1:20, using sodium sulfate as neutral salt and sodium carbonate for pH adjustment, for approximately 1.5 h. Wash with tap water and oven dry at 60 °C. Selected final add-on is 10 wt%; bath concentration, sodium sulfate/carbonate quantities, exact pH and drying duration are not reported. APPCABT is synthesized from intermediate M (0.03 mol) and POCl3 (0.03 mol) in dichloromethane at 35 °C with triethylamine maintaining pH 8–9. Isolate, wash twice with dichloromethane and vacuum dry at room temperature; source yield is 77.2%.
TGA_instrument: ZCT-A thermal analyzer; source attributes it to Perkin-Elmer International AG, USA
TGA_specimen_preparation: Cotton fabric sample weighing 5–10 mg; pan, flow, cutting/grinding and TG repetition count are not stated.
LOI_instrument: HC-2, Jiangning Analysis Instrument Company, China
LOI_locator: Printed p.1594, PDF p.3, Table 2: 10 wt% add-on; prose and p.1596 conclusion repeat LOI 27.9.
TG_locator: Printed p.1595, PDF p.4, Table 3 and section 4 explicitly identify 10 wt% APPCABT fabric in air. Table 3 footnote defines source Tonset based on 5% weight loss.
conditions_locator: Printed pp.1592–1593, Experimental sections 1–4: fabric, own LOI/TG methods, synthesis and finishing. The appended complete SI on p.1598 contains FTIR/NMR only.
pairing_evidence: Table 2 gives LOI 27.9 at 10 wt% APPCABT. Section 4, Table 3 caption and conclusion explicitly assign fabric TG to 10 wt% APPCABT. Both concern the initial fabric after the stated preparation rinse.
source_access_method: Official seven-page KIChE PDF: six-page article plus appended complete one-page SI. Whole source text and methods, numeric tables, Figure 3 and SI pixels checked.
limitations: Source Tonset is explicitly defined as 5% weight loss, so 235.4 °C is recorded as T5; canonical Tonset remains blank. Source Tmax values 323.3/500.7 °C are called maximum weight-loss temperatures without an explicit maximum-rate definition; both remain raw and canonical Tmax fields remain blank. Other 5/15/25 wt% add-ons lack own TG, and the 25 wt% LOI conflicts between Table 2 (28.3) and prose (28.2). Control LOI 17.5, residue 8.8% at 600 °C, and rounded TG onset/peaks repeat the same authors earlier 2013 source (DOI 10.1007/s11814-013-0112-x) using the same 184 g/m² supplier fabric; the control is reuse-held. Intermediate M LOI 26.1 and residue 23.0% are explicitly cited from that earlier source and excluded. No protocol is transferred to the earlier paper. The official seven-page PDF includes complete one-page SI containing spectra only. The extracted INVITED REVIEW PAPER string is not relied upon as publication classification; the body gives original Experimental sections and its own APPCABT results.
